The '''1976–77 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 41st season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league in Greece. The season began on 3 October 1976 and ended on 27 June 1977. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their 12th Greek title and their first one in five years.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
